name: Outdoor and Wilderness Leadership Skills (OWLS), Awbury Arboretum
what_you_do: Train to be a camp counselor in training. You learn to lead groups, handle conflict and camp outdoors. You also practice writing a resume and job interviews. You get American Red Cross First Aid and CPR.
pay_detail: Summer 2026 price was $675 ($641 for members) for the 2 week session. The camp page says scholarships (75% off) and sliding scale fees (30% to 60% off) are available to families in local zip codes.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 session ran June 15 to 26, 2026 and was sold out. The camp FAQ says Summer 2027 registration opens Monday, Feb. 1, 2027 at 9 am; OWLS 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up through the Awbury Adventures Summer Camp page. Ask for financial aid BEFORE you sign up, because aid spots are few.
notes: This is training, not a paid job. The page does not say whether graduates get counselor jobs. A 2021 posting on the same site said 2 to 6 trainees were chosen as stipend-paid counselors in training; that is old, so ask.
